name: 4-Starred Ladybug of Doom
implementationSummary: Added a shared flip-trigger hook in duel resolution and implemented this card as an automatic Flip Effect that destroys all face-up Level 4 monsters on opponent monster zones when flipped face-up.
acceptanceTests: Flipping a face-down 4-Starred Ladybug of Doom during combat destroys every opponent face-up Level 4 monster and leaves non-face-up and non-Level 4 monsters untouched.
The destruction effect does not target or destroy monsters on the controller's side of the field.
If the opponent has no face-up Level 4 monsters when the flip resolves, the board state is unchanged except for the source monster being face-up.
rulingNotes: Goat World text is authoritative in this environment for this card and states: FLIP: Destroy all face-up Level 4 monsters on your opponent's side of the field.
GoatFormat indivrulings page has no dedicated 4-Starred Ladybug of Doom entry in its current index, so no additional GoatFormat-specific exception or errata was discovered beyond the card text.
Flip effects are treated as trigger effects resolved when the monster is revealed face-up, before battle damage logic in this engine prototype.
notes: Audit v1 verified for 4-Starred Ladybug of Doom only.
